theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_fvu_compatible_valuation_gluing
theorems.statement: ∀ (F : ℕ → IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) (hmono : Monotone F), (∀ x : AlgebraicClosure ℚ, ∃ i : ℕ, x ∈ F i) → ∀ (V : (i : ℕ) → ValuationSubring (F i)) (ℓ : ℕ), (∀ i : ℕ, (V i).LiesOverPrime ℓ) → (∀ (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (x : F i), IntermediateField.inclusion (hmono hij) x ∈ V j ↔ x ∈ V i) → ∃ P : ValuationSubring (AlgebraicClosure ℚ), P.LiesOverPrime ℓ ∧ (∀ (i : ℕ) (x : F i), (x : AlgebraicClosure ℚ) ∈ P ↔ x ∈ V i)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
